b: Gold Coast, Australia – The MC-ZERO 450, developed in collaboration between electric propulsion specialist ZeroJet and McConaghy Boats, has won the Innovative Design Solution Award at the 2026 Boat Builder Awards, held during Metstrade in Amsterdam.

Describing the MC-ZERO 450 as a “genuine trend setter in the making,” the judges highlighted its innovative features, including the fold-down bow, movable helm and fold-down transom, recognising how the collaboration between McConaghy Boats and ZeroJet has reimagined what is possible within a compact yacht tender.

The MC-ZERO 450 combines carbon-fibre construction with ZeroJet’s electric jet propulsion technology and a highly adaptable layout. Offering approximately 40% more internal volume than a traditional RIB of similar size, the MC-ZERO 450 is designed to serve as a multi-role support boat rather than a single-purpose tender.

Propulsion comes from twin 30 kW ZeroJet electric jet drives (equivalent to 80hp total), powered by a 32.4 kWh 48-volt battery system. Delivering speeds of up to 27 knots, the twin-jet configuration offers quiet, low-maintenance operation alongside the added reassurance of propulsion redundancy.

“We’re delighted to receive this award. It’s fantastic recognition of the collaborative effort between the teams at McConaghy Boats and ZeroJet to bring the MC-ZERO 450 to life,” James Morton, CEO of ZeroJet, commented. “From the outset, we focused on what customers really want from a yacht tender: more space, greater flexibility, twin-propulsion redundancy and easier access between the mothership, tender and shore. Bringing all these innovations together in a 4.5-metre tender is something we’re incredibly proud of, and it’s great to see that recognised by the industry.”
The win comes as ZeroJet showcases its electric propulsion range at Metstrade 2026, including its electric jet and newly launched inboard systems.

MC-ZERO builds carbon electric jet tenders designed to redefine the ship-to-shore experience. Born from a commitment to solve the persistent constraints of traditional vessel design, MC-ZERO produces a range of adaptable platforms that prioritize deck space, utility, and electric propulsion. By integrating advanced systems with a signature focus on versatile layouts, including an industry-first movable helm, every MC-ZERO functions as a seamless extension of the modern yacht. The company is dedicated to improving the way owners and captains interact with the water, providing a new standard of utility for tenders.
